Container.Name: retrogametalk-sync
Container.Overview: Always-on archival mirror, offline game catalog browser, and direct browser-to-SD-card ROM installer for RetroGameTalk with adaptive AIMD rate limiting and a retro CRT phosphor web console.
Container.Requires: Requires an account at retrogametalk.com. Keep Appdata (/run/repo/.rgt-data) on fast SSD/NVMe cache so SQLite WAL writes stay responsive.

Config.Name: Web Console Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the RetroGameTalk Sync CRT web console, health probes, and Prometheus metrics.

Config.Name: Mirrored ROMs Directory
Config.Description: Host share where mirrored console/release ROM directories are written (DOWNLOAD_DIR).

Config.Name: Appdata & SQLite State
Config.Description: Fast SSD/NVMe cache folder for scraper.db (SQLite WAL), cookies, encryption keyfile, and lazy cover/screenshot cache (DATA_DIR).

Config.Name: DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Internal container path for SQLite database and metadata caches.

Config.Name: DOWNLOAD_DIR
Config.Description: Internal container path for mirrored ROM archives.

Config.Name: RetroGameTalk Username
Config.Description: Optional RetroGameTalk username. Leave blank to configure interactively in the Web UI.

Config.Name: RetroGameTalk Password
Config.Description: Optional RetroGameTalk password. Leave blank to configure interactively in the Web UI.

Config.Name: Cron Schedule
Config.Description: 5-field cron expression for scheduled background syncs.

Config.Name: System Filter
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated console slugs (e.g. nes,snes,gba). Leave empty to manage in UI.

Config.Name: Release Type Filter
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated release types (e.g. Retail ROM,Translation,Hack). Leave empty to manage in UI.

Config.Name: Debug Logging
Config.Description: Set true for verbose scrape, download, archive, and SD-install logs.
